prompt_text: Who is the best dentist in Chicago for a dental implant?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one single “best” dentist for an implant in Chicago — the right provider depends on your needs (complexity of the case, medical history, budget, insurance, comfort with sedation, cosmetic goals). Here’s how to find the best clinician for you and some places to start.

Who should place and restore implants
- Oral & maxillofacial surgeons (OMS) — specialists in surgery, bone grafts, extractions, and complex cases.
- Periodontists — specialists in gums and implants, good for bone/gum regeneration.
- Prosthodontists — specialists in restoring teeth; ideal if you need complex crowns/bridges or full-arch work.
Often a team (surgeon + prosthodontist) gives the best result for complex restorations.

How to choose a provider
- Board credentials: ABOMS (oral surgery), American Board of Periodontology, or American Board of Prosthodontics — board certification is a strong indicator of advanced training.
- Experience: number of implants placed, experience with your specific case (single tooth vs. All-on-4 vs. full-arch).
- Technology: CBCT (3D) imaging, guided implant surgery, digital planning.
- Before/after photos and patient references.
- Complication/failure rates and how they handle revisions.
- Sedation/anesthesia options and medical clearance processes.
- Warranty/guarantee on the implant/restoration and clear cost breakdown.
- Reviews and reputation (Google, Healthgrades, Zocdoc, Yelp) — prioritize verified patient feedback.

Good places to look in Chicago
- Academic/medical centers (best for complex cases or second opinions): University of Chicago Medicine, Northwestern Memorial Hospital / Feinberg School, Rush University Medical Center, University of Illinois at Chicago (UIC) College of Dentistry.
- Professional directories: AAOMS “Find a Surgeon,” American Academy of Implant Dentistry (AAID), ADA Find-a-Dentist.
- Local highly rated private practices (search reviews and check credentials).

Questions to ask at a consult
- How many implants like mine have you placed?
- Will you do the surgery and the restoration, or will I see two specialists?
- Do you use CBCT and guided planning? Can I see before/after photos?
- What implant brand do you use and why?
- Do you anticipate bone grafts or sinus lifts? What is the timeline?
- What are total costs, payment options, and what’s included?
- What are your complication and success rates?
- What anesthesia/sedation options are offered?

If you’d like, tell me your Chicago neighborhood or ZIP code, whether you have insurance, and whether it’s a single tooth or a full-arch case — I can suggest several highly rated providers or academic clinics nearby and help you narrow choices.
